title: Bridge index and nonorientable four-genus of knots with at most thirteen crossings: papers, certificates and verifiers

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India; Formerly, University of Calcutta, Senate House, 87/1 College Street, Kolkata 700073, West Bengal, India

description:
Papers, certificates and verifiers for two partial results on the KnotInfo tables (version 2026.10.5), by Deep Bhattacharjee. Neither has been refereed.

Transvections and the bridge index of thirteen-crossing knots (paper/bridge13.pdf). KnotInfo lists the bridge index of 536 prime knots with 13 crossings as [3,4]. For 243 of them the bridge index is 4 and equals the meridional rank, so the meridional rank conjecture holds for these knots; the lower bound is a representation of the knot group sending the meridian to a transvection of Sp(4, F3) or Sp(4, F5), or a reflection of O(4, F5). The other 293 stay open; Alexander-quandle colourings and closed 3-braids in a bounded range settle none of them.

Pinch moves and the nonorientable four-genus of knots with at most thirteen crossings (crosscap4d/paper/crosscap4d.pdf). KnotInfo leaves the smooth nonorientable four-genus open for 3,525 prime knots with 11 to 13 crossings. One pinch move to a slice knot, or to a knot of known nonorientable four-genus, settles 2,093 of them and lowers the upper bound of 575 more; 1,432 stay open. Every certificate is checked in Regina by a program independent of the search.

The archive holds both papers with their TeX sources (paper/, crosscap4d/paper/, each with paper1/ for the PDF and paper2/ for the TeX zip), one certificate per knot (data/, crosscap4d/data/), the lists of open knots, the verifiers (verify/, crosscap4d/verify/) and the search programs.
